claim_boundary: Partner selection and content response are behavioral task measures; neither alone establishes words, compositionality or human language origin.

config.evaluation: complete heldout_layout at six checkpoints and complete train/heldout_layout final partitions
config.message_panel: target heldout-resource full trajectories; six actor/window panels; no monitor subsets
config.pairing: same initial parameters, world uniforms and message uniforms across all eight arms within each seed
config.payoff_intervention: partial: native 0/.5/1; all_or_nothing: training table maps .5 to 0; native settlement unchanged
config.selection: fixed four pilot seeds ×2 payoff modes ×2 rules ×2 channels ×6000 updates; no early stopping
config.semantic_holdout: resource predicates 5=wood-long and 6=fiber-short are absent from factorial training; broad predicates and the opposite singleton corners remain present

native_settlement: Unchanged strict/reciprocal physical settlement; payoff intervention affects only training objective.
observations: PL own need and public layout; other private needs remain hidden; object, attribute, partner and destination demands retained.
primary: centered time-AUC of (all_or_nothing live−silent)−(partial live−silent) on correct executed-pair rate
scientific_question: Does removing partial-success utility make communication select the state-appropriate partner and support content response?
